source: NOIRLab Astro Data Lab TAP, table delve_dr3.decade_shear (DECADE weak-lensing shape catalogue released in DELVE DR3).  Unauthenticated: no credentials are sent.
exact_query_template: SELECT ra,dec,mcal_g_1_noshear,mcal_g_2_noshear,mcal_w_noshear,dnf_z,mcal_g_1_1p,mcal_g_1_1m,mcal_g_2_2p,mcal_g_2_2m FROM delve_dr3.decade_shear WHERE 't' = q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, <RA>, <DEC>, <radius_deg>) AND mcal_flags = 0 AND flags_foreground = 0 AND flags_footprint = 1 AND mcal_sel_noshear > 0 AND dnf_z > 0 AND dnf_z < 3
raw_response_kept: acquire/decade_raw/ (first system queried, verbatim, with its query)

columns.name: beta
columns.note: weighted <D_ls/D_s> of the bin's background sources

cuts: mcal_flags = 0 AND flags_foreground = 0 AND flags_footprint = 1 AND mcal_sel_noshear > 0 AND dnf_z > 0 AND dnf_z < 3 AND dnf_z > z_cl + 0.2
binning: 10 log bins over 0.2-3.5 h^-1 Mpc physical, h = 0.7; identical to Chiu+2022
caveat: DECADE is DECam, not HSC.  It is shallower than the HSC S19A catalogue Chiu+2022 used, and its photo-z are DNF point estimates rather than full P(z).  It is, however, RAW per-source shear, which is what the test requires.
